case.summary: Case HHG-009 covers a online $30.02 transaction 3581141 on card C08299-K1 raised by a customer_report trigger. Graph investigation found 3 corroborating signal(s) - 48h burst, shared-device ring, device linked to prior fraud. Pattern assessed as none; fraud probability 0.42 before additional evidence and 0.42 after, giving a verdict of uncertain. Exposure across 6 transaction(s) is $635.02. The graph does not corroborate the alert strongly enough to block, so under R1 the card stays active, the case stays open and the requested verification is recorded as outstanding.
